rachel_pm: Quick pitch: time-windowed hedge commits (TWHC). Customers commit capacity that is partitioned across time windows + a small regional hedge pool. Purpose: lower unit cost while protecting sudden regional spikes. feedback?

diego_eng: high level mechanics?

rachel_pm: customer selects windows (e.g., business-hours, weekend, campaign-hours). Commit = sum(window_allocs) + regional_hedge H. During a window, requests consume window alloc first, then hedge, then on-demand. Hedge is globally preemptible.

yara_ops: ops needs: per-window burn metrics, hedge_preempt_events, region_disable. Also a global kill switch for hedge.

ben_sales: GTM: two offers: predictable (fixed windows) and flexible (auto-rebalance across windows). Pricing example in proto sheet. Customers like being able to buy capacity aligned with traffic patterns.

kevin_sre: preemption semantics? if hedge is revoked mid-flight, allow in-flight to finish up to grace_tokens G. Block new hedge allocations immediately.

diego_eng: router change: tag tokens with window_id or hedge. Admission order: window -> hedge -> on-demand. Add per-tenant sliding counters per window. Need TTLs for window expirations.

anya_research: QA: simulate timezone skew, overlapping windows, and misconfigured windows (e.g., customer schedules wrong timezone). Also include quality checks for hedge-driven requests.

yara_ops: runbook: alert if hedge_preempt_rate > 1.5% for 10m or window_burn_rate > 95% for 5m. Add dashboard: per-window burn, time-to-exhaust, latency delta vs baseline.
achel_pm: config proto I dropped in specs: https://redwood.internal/specs/twhc-proto. It has window defs, hedge_pct, grace_tokens, preempt_threshold.

diego_eng: effort: admission + per-window state ~3 sprints; console UX + billing + telemetry parallel. Perf risk: per-tenant windows in hotpath. We'll scope to sampled-heavy tenants first.

ben_sales: pilot plan: 8 customers across ecommerce and ad-tech with predictable windows. Offer onboarding help for window config.

rachel_pm: action items: @diego_eng start api proto, @yara_ops list telemetry + dashboard mocks, @ben_sales identify pilots, @anya_research create eval scenarios. Target Q3 pilot if no legal/billing blockers. :rocket:
